name: PLC
summary: PLC (Price Level Channel) is an Expert Advisor that identifies dynamic price channels and trades breakouts from those channels. It automatically detects support and resistance levels, enters trades when price breaks out of the established channel, and manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: PLC（价格水平通道）是一个Expert Advisor，通过识别动态价格通道并在价格突破通道时进行交易。它自动检测支撑和阻力水平，当价格突破已建立的通道时入场，并使用可配置的止损和止盈管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: PLC策略的核心概念是基于价格通道的突破交易，通过动态计算近期价格的高点和低点形成通道上下轨。入场条件为当价格突破通道上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空，表明趋势可能启动。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及通道反向突破时的平仓信号。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的可选方式，但未包含加仓或减仓逻辑。资金管理方面提供风险百分比参数，允许用户根据账户余额调整每笔交易的风险敞口。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺乏对假突破的过滤机制，可能在震荡行情中产生较多虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the PLC strategy is channel breakout trading, where dynamic price channels are formed by calculating recent price highs and lows to create upper and lower channel boundaries. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above the upper channel boundary and a sell when price breaks below the lower boundary, signaling a potential trend initiation. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as position closure signals when the channel is breached in the opposite direction. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or an optional equity-proportional method, but the strategy lacks scaling in or scaling out logic. Money management provides a risk percentage parameter allowing users to adjust exposure per trade based on account balance. While the overall strategy logic is clear, it lacks a false breakout filter mechanism, which may generate numerous false signals during ranging market conditions.

pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，基于价格通道突破的经典技术分析方法
参数可配置性强，用户可根据市场环境调整通道周期和风险参数
包含止损止盈设置，具备基本的风险控制机制
通道动态更新，能够适应市场波动率的变化
pros_en: Clear and straightforward strategy logic based on the classic technical analysis method of price channel breakouts
Highly configurable parameters allowing users to adjust channel period and risk settings based on market conditions
Includes stop loss and take profit settings providing a basic risk control mechanism
Dynamic channel updates that can adapt to changes in market volatility
cons: 缺乏假突破过滤机制，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和亏损交易
未包含加仓、减仓或移动止损等高级仓位管理功能
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下交易成本可能侵蚀利润
缺乏多时间周期确认，仅依赖单一周期的通道判断
cons_en: Lacks a false breakout filter mechanism, prone to generating frequent false signals and losing trades in ranging markets
Does not include advanced position management features such as scaling in/out or trailing stops
No spread filter, meaning high spread environments can erode profits through trading costs
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, relying solely on single-timeframe channel assessment
improvements: 增加成交量或动量指标作为突破确认过滤器，减少假突破导致的亏损交易
添加移动止损功能以锁定浮动利润，并引入多时间周期确认逻辑提高信号可靠性
增加点差和滑点过滤，避免在高成本环境下开仓
improvements_en: Add volume or momentum indicators as breakout confirmation filters to reduce losing trades from false breakouts
Implement trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits and introduce multi-timeframe confirmation logic to improve signal reliability
Add spread and slippage filters to avoid opening positions in high-cost environments

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡市中可能产生连续假信号导致多次止损
缺乏点差过滤，在流动性较差时段可能因高点差而亏损
固定止损可能不适应所有市场波动环境，过大或过小都不合适
risk_points_en: Breakout strategies may generate consecutive false signals in ranging markets leading to multiple stop losses
Lack of spread filter can result in losses during low-liquidity sessions due to wide spreads
Fixed stop loss may not suit all market volatility environments, being either too wide or too narrow

It automatically detects support and resistance levels, enters trades when price breaks out of the established channel, and manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
